acceptance: The checker ignores gitignored paths and virtual environments while still scanning every tracked file; a test proves both.
description:
## Problem
`make windows-antipatterns-check` (scripts/check_windows_antipatterns.py) walks the source roots with `rglob("*.py")` and excludes only `_project/sql-translation-ml`, so a gitignored virtual environment such as `_project/scripts/.venv` (created by uv in a linked worktree) is scanned. Seen 2026-10-28 (WA002 in uvicorn; deleting the directory fixed it) and again 2026-11-21 in two run-timeout worktrees: 25 WA002 hits, all inside `_project/scripts/.venv`, none in tracked files. The check exits 2 locally while CI, which has no such directory, passes, so local results mislead.

## Change
Scan only tracked files (`git ls-files`) or skip gitignored paths and directories that contain `pyvenv.cfg`.

## Decision gates
Tracked files must still all be scanned; the baseline file (`quality/windows-antipatterns-baseline.json`) must not change because of this fix. If excluding a tracked path seems necessary, STOP and ask.

## Verification rubric
A test creates a fake gitignored `.venv` with a violating file inside a temporary repository and the check passes; a violating tracked file still fails it; `make windows-antipatterns-check` exits 0 in a worktree that has `_project/scripts/.venv`; `make pr-preflight` exits 0.

## Guardrails
Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`), never the primary clone. Edit files with the edit tool, never by script. Heavy work (benchmarks, test tiers, UAT, generators at scale) only through `make heavy-run` or lock-taking entry points; never skip the lock, admission or watchdog; never delete anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. No live cloud run and no cloud credentials unless this item's Decision gates say the owner approved it in the current task. BenchBox imposes no default run limit: add none. No comments or docstrings in first-party code; one changelog fragment for a user-facing change. Never post a stand-in review, close and reopen a pull request to restart CI, use `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite an author. Arm once; a second time only after fixing the cause the refusal named. Reply on every review thread; resolve it only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise it again.
